comment: Pinned model provenance. get_models.sh fetches into models/cache/ and verifies SHA256. YOLOv8n is not listed here: its ONNX is produced locally by tools/export/export_yolo.py (opset 12, static shapes, nms=False) because Ultralytics does not publish a canonical ONNX artifact.
